entry.name: rnbo_wave~
entry.digest: Linear interpolated multi-channel lookup of a buffer.
entry.description: wave~ reads from a portion of a buffer~ to produce a repeating waveform, given a signal input that goes between 0. and 1. (for example, using a phasor~ ) to define the position in the buffer.

arguments.name: buffername
arguments.description: Name of the buffer to read samples from

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: Sets the number of output channels, which determines the number of outlets that theobject will have. If theobject being played byhas more channels than the number of outputs of, the extra channels are not played. If theobject has fewer channels, the extrasignal outputs are 0.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description: Set the start point of the wavetable. By default, the start point is 0. If you want to set a non-zero start point but retain the sample end as the waveform end point, use only a single typed-in argument after the buffer name. Theobject uses the buffer's sampling rate to determine loop points.

arguments.name: end
arguments.description: Set the end point of the wavetable. By default, the end point is the end of the sample. If a signal is connected to the end point (right) inlet, the initial waveform end point is ignored.
